steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A work order needs its materials, a routing and a capacity figure with a source before release.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Material short for the run
findings.fix: Hold the order until the material is in

findings.title: Capacity figure with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the capacity

outcome.notChecked: Whether the routing matches the product's current design.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] wo-4412.md:12  Material short for the run.
       Fix: Hold the order until the material is in.
[medium] wo-4415.md:19  Routing missing.
       Fix: Attach the routing.
[low] wo-4413.md:26  Capacity figure with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the capacity.
Not checked: Whether the routing matches the product's current design.
pros: Checks a material short for the run, a routing missing, and a capacity figure with no source.
cons: Not checked: Whether the routing matches the product's current design.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-work-order-release skill on the records for this review.
